title: Electric field at surface
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the electric field at the dome's surface using E = V/a.

title: Dome time constant
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the time constant τ = RC, using the dome's capacitance and the total resistance of the resistor chain.

title: Belt charge density
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the required surface charge density on the belt, accounting for both the resistor chain current and the proton beam current.

title: Magnetic field strength
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the magnetic field strength from the given deflection angle, using the appropriate relativistic or non-relativistic circular motion formula.

title: Pipe length and resistance
description: Important: Correctly calculates the length of copper pipe in one spiral and its electrical resistance using the given geometry and resistivity.

title: Cooling water flow rate
description: Important: Correctly calculates the required water flow rate by equating the electrical power dissipated to the thermal power carried away by the water.

title: Distance of closest approach
description: Important: Correctly calculates the distance of closest approach for the proton to the fluorine nucleus using conservation of energy for electrostatic repulsion.

title: Incorrect current summation
description: Pitfall: Fails to sum the resistor chain current and the proton beam current when calculating the required belt charge density for part (c).

title: Unit conversion errors
description: Pitfall: Makes errors in unit conversions (e.g., microamperes, megohms, millimeters to meters) leading to incorrect numerical answers.

title: Geometry for pipe length
description: Optional: Correctly derives or applies the formula for the length of a flat spiral coil based on the given inner and outer diameters and pipe diameter.
